correctness.rationale: Enumerated exact vertex graph distances: for distinct arms, d(v_{i,a},v_{j,b})=min(a+b,2L−a−b), hence forbidden pairs at diameter L are the pole pair, complementary levels a+ b=L with different arm labels, and for even L a middle-level K_m. As disjoint forbidden-pair components this is K2 plus floor((L−1)/2) crown graphs K_{m,m}−M_m plus a middle K_m for even L. Complement flag/Rips complex is literal simplicial join S⁰*D_m^{*k} for odd L=2k+1, or S⁰*D_m^{*(k−1)}*E_m for even L=2k. Each D_m consists of two contractible shores joined by m independent bridges, so integral H1(D_m)=A_m and D_m~vee^{m−1}S¹; E_m~vee^{m−1}S⁰. Join Künneth gives precisely the wedge, sphere dimension, no torsion, and tensor-power arm representation. Pole reversal acts −1 on pole S⁰ and each crown H1, with middle E fixed, yielding odd (−1)^{k+1} and even (−1)^k. At m=2 the two-arm graph is a cycle and the natural action still exists, but the full automorphism assertion applies only m≥3. Independently recomputed forbidden-pair join factorization in 28 (m,L) cases; exact all-parameter proof is combinatorial.
